🧠 Crypto News Brief: Uptober is stalling: bitcoin clings to $83K as leverage flushes, ETF outflows and rising yields weigh on risk appetite. Security scares at Ledger and the XRP Ledger add caution, while banks keep building stablecoin rails. 📉 Bitcoin Steadies Above $83K After an $800M Leverage Flush A sell-off in Asian chip stocks spilled into crypto, briefly dragging bitcoin below $81,000 and liquidating about $803 million in leveraged positions within 24 hours, 86% of them bullish bets. Samsung and SK Hynix each dropped roughly 8%, and tokenized SanDisk contracts even saw more liquidations than XRP. BTC later recovered above $83,000, with shorts absorbing most of the follow-up wipeouts. Read full story 💸 Spot Crypto ETF Outflows Deepen Ahead of CPI US spot bitcoin ETFs lost another $65 million on Monday after shedding about $680 million last week, leaving them net negative by roughly $451 million for October; ether funds have bled around $720 million this month. Elevated oil prices and 30-year Treasury yields near their highest since 2002 keep risk appetite thin before Wednesday's US inflation report. More details 🔐 Ledger Ties Suspected $87M Wallet Drain to Reseller CryptoBilis Ledger says every confirmed case in last week's draining incident involves devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis, which has stopped all hardware wallet sales; at least one device contained an unauthorized hardware implant. On-chain investigators trace more than $86 million in suspected thefts across Ethereum, Tron and Bitcoin. Ledger urges affected buyers to move funds to a new seed phrase on a device bought directly from the company. Read more 🏦 Standard Chartered Launches Custody for Ripple's RLUSD in Dubai Standard Chartered's DIFC branch now offers institutional custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger. The bank also joined a planned LMAX Group integration that would let clients post RLUSD as trading collateral while the tokens stay in bank custody, a leg still pending documentation and regulatory approval. RLUSD's market cap has grown to roughly $2.45 billion. See details 🐞 XRP Ledger Patches a Decade-Old Counterfeiting Bug XRPL maintainers disclosed an integer-overflow flaw in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, that could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the total supply in a single transaction.
